tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ ye shes rang bzhin bde ba'i gter/ /chos dbyings mkha' mnyam dbang phyug ma/ /grub pa kun gyi mchog stsol mdzad/ /rdo rje lha mos dge legs stsol/ /thar pa dam pa'i grong khyer du/ /skal ldan gzhug pa'i sgo mo brgya/ /de las gcig gcig 'dir dbye ste/ /rgyal ba'i lam 'di thun mong min/ /'dir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje gdan bzhi las 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rje btsun ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can sgrub par 'dod pas/ sgrub pa dngos kyi rim pa dang*/ rjes thun mtshams kyi chos so/ /dang po la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te bskyed rim dngos dang*/ yan lag bzlas pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /yang na dbye ba gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin te gsum mo/ /de rnams kyi dbye ba'i sdom ni/ rten sbyang mchod sgrub bgegs bsrung dang*/ /tshogs bsag rnams ni rnal 'byor ro/ /bskul bas bzhengs dang byin gyis brlab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod rjes rnal 'byor/ /rten bskyed brten pa bskyed pa dang*/ / byin brlab shin tu rnal 'byor yin/ /dgug gzhug phyag rgyas rgyas btab dang*/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po yin par bshad/ /de ltar yan lag bcu bzhi ni/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yis bsdus pa yin/ /yang na ting 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus/ /gtso mo bskyed pa yan chad ni/ /dang po sbyor ba yin par 'dod/ /rten dang brten pa bskyed pa gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog zhes su bya/ /rnal 'byor chen por gang bstan pa/ de ni las rgyal mchog yin no/ /mngon rtogs chings ni gnyis yod kyang*/ /yan lag bcu bzhir mtshungs pa yin/

/de la yan lag bcu bzhi ni/ rten sbyang ba/ mchod pa sgrub pa bgegs bsrung ba/ tshogs bsag pa/ bskul nas bzhengs ba byin gyis brlab pa dbang bskur ba mchod cing bstod pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa brten pa lha tshogs spro ba go cha byin gyis brlab pa ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug phyag rgyas btab pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams so/ /de la dang po bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du tsan dan dmar po la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa/ mdun du mchod yon g.yas su nyer spyod/ g.yon du gsang chu rnams bsham/ skyabs sems dang yig brgya ci rigs pa jon du btang la/ dang po rten sbyang ba ni/ rang skad cig gis ye shes mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba'i snying chu shing gi me tog 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa ni sems sbyang ba'o/ / lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a yig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la āḥsuṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pa'i mthil du soṃ yig las zla ba/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la/ saṃ rnams las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga par gyur/ lag pa byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po/ lce'i 'dab mar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥdzi ha saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg cing*/ spyi bo k+ṣuṃ mig gnyis su hūṃ/ rna ba dang sna la yum/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par / dpung par / snying gar /lte bar ces byin gy-is brlab bo/ / gnyis pa mchod pa sgrub pa ni/ seng ge mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ zhes mang du bzlas pas bsang chu bsgrubs la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya mchod yon gyi snod dang gtor ma la reg ste/

oṃ hūṃ swahā/ zhes lan bdun/ ār+ya de ba'i gzhung dngos las mchod yon kho nas bsang chu byed par bshad kyang lag len du bsang chu logs su byed pas/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i bsang chus/ gnas dang mchod rdzas la gtor la/ oṃ sarba bi ma la saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gser gyi snod bzang zhing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ baṃ hūṃ shriṃ kuṃ k+ṣuṃ iṃ guṃ rnams las byung ba'i mchod rdzas zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ pra tī ts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūṃ/ g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub sbyar ba dang*/ pra ba ra sata kā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ de bzhinadu dri chab la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ oṃ kuṃ swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣuṃ swāhā/ oṃ iṃ swāhā/ oṃ guṃ swāhā/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ gsum pa bgegs bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mthe bong gnyis sbrail/ sor mo lhag ma ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu phyir ldog la snying gar bzhag oṃ badz+ra ka wa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag bsrung ba'o/ /sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya phyogs kun du bskor la/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ phur bu'i sa gzhi dang rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra bar gyur/ gnas bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gan kyal las 'dzub mo brkyang ba rtse sprad de ldog nas snying ga dang rgyab dang spyi bo rnams su lan gsum bskor nas/ oṃ ḍa ṭ+wuṃ hūṃ swāhā/ mnyam pa'i thal mo lan gsum gdab ste/ oṃ badz+ra tu sh+ya hoḥ ces go cha bcing ba ni rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ / bzhi pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/

de la mchod pa ni g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyang ste/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ me tog dang*/ lag pa brkyang ste dris byug pa'i tshul du/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ dri chab dang*/ lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo bsgreng zhing sor mo lhag ma'i rtse sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ kuṃ swāhā/ bdug spos so/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur las mthe bong bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ k+ṣu swāhā/ mar me'o/ /thal mo kha gyen du phye ba las/ mthe bong gnyis dbus su bskyod pa dang*/ oṃ iṃ swāhā/ zhal zas dang*/ de nyid las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa dang*/ oṃ guṃ swāhā sa gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro bas thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ na ma ste hūṃ na mā mi hūm̐ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pañca ḍā ki nī pū dza u pa sa thā nā ya at+mā nāṃ nīr ya ta yā mi/ oṃ ā tsīr+ya pū dza u pa sa thā nā ya at+mā nāṃ nā+-ir+ya ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka la twa pa ri tra ṇā ya āt+ma nāṃ nīr+ya ta yā mi/ sa ma ya stāṃ/ sa ma ya ho ho hoḥ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gyis phyag bya/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag gi skyabs su mchi/ /thams cad theg pa gsum po dang*/ /sbyor ba gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog / snang ba mtha' yas don yod sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo zhes bya ba bdag /dus 'di nye bar bzung nas su/ /byang chub chen po thob kyi bar/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub du ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/

/dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / ces lan gsum/ /mchod yul rang la thim/ lnga pa bskul zhing bzhengs pa ni/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣuṃ yig dmar po'i 'od zer kyis rang lus dang snod bcud thams cad bsregs te stong nyid du sbyangs/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi sku la gnas par gyur/ /oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥdzaḥrdo rje sems dpa' dngos grub bzhugs pa'i bdag po khyod/ /ha ha ha ha hūṃ yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ba ba ba ba rdo rje sgrog gi gsang ba las byung sku 'dzin pa/ a a a a a ho mgu ba'i rdo rje a li gcig tu thim pa'i hūṃ/

de nas stong pa'i ngang las a ā i ī u ū ri rī l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis par gyur/ dz+nya no ྅haṃ/ zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ rdo rje de las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ zhing khams thams cad du sems can gyi don byas/ slar yang rdo rje de nyid la thim oṃ brta mo no3haṃ hoḥ de las rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo char sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu 'od zer 'bar ba/ rtsa zhal mthing kha shas cher khros pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ sangs rgyas lnga dang thod skam kyis dbu la brgyan pa/ na bza' dmar po bsnams zhing sbrul dang rin po che'i spras pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar ba dang*/ dgra sta dang*/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu dang*/ thugs kar gtod pa'i thod pa dang*/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ seṅge'i gdan gyi steng du pad nyi la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rang 'od kyi rdo rje sems dpa' la 'khyud pa'o/ /oṃ ud+bha wo3haṃ ā ā ā aṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā yo3haṃ/ drug pa byin kyis brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin yan lag brgyad bsrung ba dang*/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra bākya āḥ.oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams ky-i+is rgyas btab/

bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mtha' bzhi lcags sgrog ltar 'dud/ dbus gnyis rtse sbyar/ bar pa bzhi brkyang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying ga dpral ba mgrin pa spyi bo rnams su reg cing*/ sa ma yo3haṃ hūṃ hūṃ sa ma yo s+t+waṃ a dh-i tiṣ+ta māṃ/ ces brjod/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya mgo bo'i gnas lngar reg ste/ oṃ hūṃ āḥswāhā/ rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ brgyad pa mchod bstod ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe mā le swāhā/ oṃ dhū pe shwa ri hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tik+ṣ+ṇa dī pe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha su gan+dhe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru mahā ba li hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ rdo rje bzung*/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ dril bu dkrol/ 'phrog byed cod pan nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs gnyis brgyan/ /dril bu las byung thugs kar dam du 'khyud pa'i sku/ /zhabs gnyis bskyod pas gsang ba las byung pad+mar sbyor/ /rdo rje sems mdzes dbang phyug dam pa'i go 'phang mchog / ces bstod/ dgu pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i rgyab dang*/ g.yas kyi mdun sbyar bas dbang ldan nas brtsoms te bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ lag gnyis phan tshun rtse sprad/ oṃ dzuṃ swāhā/ steng du rdo rje dra ba dang*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis mthe bo sa la btsugs te/ oṃ bh+ruṃ swāhā/ 'og tu phur bu'i sa gzhi dang*/ de rnams steng du bskor te/ oṃ dzaṃ swāhā/ nam mkha' la rdo rje'i bla bre'o/ / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yum las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam k+ṣuṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ suṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/

hūṃ suṃ hūṃ las ri rab lhun po lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ / rdo rje bsdam pa kha sbub ste sa la bzhag oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i steng du rin po che'i sna bdun gyis spras pa'i gser gyi gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang ldan pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ka ba dang*/ dril bu la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pas steng thog rim par phub pa/ dbus phyur bu'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ser nub dmar lho nag dbus sngo ba'i steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ / gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol pad+ma'i khor yug dang*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ me'i khor yug gis bskor ba/ nang gi pad+ma'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la seng ge'i gdan pad nyi dang bcas pa/ steng gi nam mkha' la gdugs dkar po re res brgyan pa'o/ /byang shar du glang po che/ shar lhor rin po che'i sna bdun gyi khri/ lho nub tu ma he/ nub byang du sbrul/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan de rnams kyi steng du'ang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /

bcu pa brten pa lha tshogs spro ba ni/ bdag nyid nam mkhar gnas pa'i thugs ka na khams lnga'i dwangs ma rlung 'od kyi gong bu gzhal med khang gnas su babs shing*/ zhugs pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ du gyur/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo nas sems pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / 'di spyi ther ba rnam rgyal dbang po dang*/ rngog pa'i bzhed pa ni/ nam mkha'i lha nyid babs par bzhed do/ / rang gi snying gar zla ba la yi ge rlung gi rang bzhin gy-i lha tshogs rnams 'khod par bsam rang gi thugs ka nas nam mkha'i rlung hūṃ zhes spros pa las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes dbang phyug ma dang bcas pa dbus kyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ rang gi chu'i rlung suṃ zhes bya bas phyung ba las shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i mdog can/ me'i rlung k+ṣuṃ zhes bya bas phyung ba las byang du drag mo mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can/ rlung gi rlung yuṃ zhes bya ba bas phyung ba las nub tu ro langs mkha' 'gro ma byi ru'i mdog can/ sa'i rlung hūṃ zhes bya bas phyung ba las lhor gdol ba mo mkha' 'gro ma bung ba'i mdog can/ de bzhi kar yang gos dmar po bsnams shing*/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /me chu 'dres pa'i rlung zhes pas spros pa las/ byang shar du seng ge gdong ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ chu sa 'dres pa'i rlung zhes pas spros pa las shar lhor stag gdong ma g.yas dkar g.yon jo ba/ sa rlung 'dres pa'i rlung zhes pas spros pa las lho nub tu ce spyang gdong g.yas jo g.yon dmar ba/ rlung me 'dres pa'i rlung zhes bya bas spros pa las nub byang du 'ug gdong ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ de rnams mdzes pa'i na bza' can/

g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig 'dzub mdzad pa/ gsher byed kyi rlung phuṃ zhes bya bas spros pa las shar sgor rgyal dbang ma dkar mo lag pa'i rtse gnyis khar bcug nas drag tu rgod pa/ sreg byed kyi rlung phreṃ zhes bya bas spros pa las byang sgor 'bar byed ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas gnas pa/ g.yos byed kyi rlung phroṃ zhes bya bas spros pa las nub sgor 'thib byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang nas gsol ba/ nor 'dzin gyi rlung phriṃ zhes bya bas spros pa las lho sgor 'phrog byed ma'am g.yo ldan ma nag mo g.yas sdigs 'dzub dang*/ g.yon gtun shing bsnams pa/ de ltar sgo skyong bzhi ni zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ shin tu 'jig shing mche ba gtsigs ma/ / dbu skra dmar ser grol zhing 'phyang ba/ /sbrul la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyi 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ / bcu gcig pa go cha byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg ste/ lce la suṃ/ sogs bu ga brgyad gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra wā kya āḥ oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ zhes so/ /bcu gnyis pa ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe mā le sogs mchod pa lngas gong bzhin mchod/ 'phrog byed cod paṇa sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha a sa na hūṃ phaṭa kyis gdan phul bcu gsum pa phyag rgyas btab pa ni/

oṃ hūṃ haḥs ma ya yu tiṣ+ṭha dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya staṃ sa ma yo3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags dang*/ g.yas dang g.yon du pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa bcing pa ni/ phyag rgya thams cad kyi sngon 'gro ba yin la/ de 'dra re re'i mthar so so'i phyag rgya 'ching ba las rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar bzhag g.yas pa mchan khung g.yon du bcug pa dang*/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ lha spyi'i dam rgya'o/ rdo rje khu tshur ram rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba dang*/ oṃ a hūṃ swāhā/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i 'o/ /sor mo bsnol lag mthil lan gsum brdeb/ mthe bong thal mo'i dbus su bskyod pa dang*/ oṃ a swāhā/ rdo rje mi'o/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ ā swāhā drag mo'i 'o/ /de nas mthe chung gnyis bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ ro langs ma'i 'o/ /de nyid las gung mo bsgreng ba/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ gdol pa mo'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad pa las 'dzub mo gnyis rtse sgur mor brkyang ba ni mtshams kyi lha mo bzh-i ste/ oṃ ṛ swāhā/ seng ge mo'i 'o/ / oṃ ṝ swāhā/ stag mo'i 'o/ / oṃ l̥ swāhā/ zhes ces spyang mo'i 'o/ / oṃ l̥̄ swāhā/ 'ug pa mo'i 'o/ /thal mo gnyis kha phye ste mthe bong khar bcug pa dang*/ oṃ phuṃ swāhā/ rgyal dbang mo'i 'o/ /sor mo bsnol ba'i thal mo spyir bor bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ phreṃ swāhā/ 'bar byed ma'i 'o/ /thal mo sbyar te kha phye ba kha'i thad dam gsang gnas su bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ phroṃ swāhā/ 'thib byed ma'i 'o/ /pad skor gyi mthar sor mo skye gnas dbye ba'i tshul lam/ yang na rdo rje bsdams pa las 'dzub mo gnyis brkyang ba gsang bar bzhag pa'am/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur rna ba'i rtsar bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ phriṃ swāhā/ 'phrog byed ma'i 'o/ /yang na de bzhi la/ oṃ iṃ swāhā/ oṃ eṃ swāhā/

oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyang bshad de/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i sngags de dag lan bdun bdun gyis brtan par byed pa'o/ /'di dag ni dam tshig gi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa yin te/ gdan bzhi'i bsdus rgyud gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa las 'di tsam kho na gsungs pas/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor la phyag rgya rgyas 'debs gzhan rnams mi dgos la/ dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags dang*/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs rnams las ni/ phyag rgya bzhi rgyas btab tu gsungs te/ rgyud rgyas pa'i dgongs par 'dod do/ /yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur/ lha thams cad la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ bcu bzhi pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ nyer spyod lnga dang sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang gtor ma sogs byin gyis brlab par mos la/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswāhā/ lan mang du brjod/ gong bzhin/ puṣ+pe mā me la sogs pa mchod pa lngas mchod/ spro na phyag rgya nyi shus kyang mchod cing sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod par mos la/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ sgeg mo dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hoḥswāhā/ pi waṃ ma dang*/ kha'i rtsar mdzub mos g.yab pas/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā glu ma dang*/ oṃ su n-ir t+ya swāhā/ gar ma dang*/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā dri chab ma dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ me tog ma dang*/ oṃ kuṃ swāhā/ bdug spos ma dang*/ oṃ k+ṣuṃ swāhā/ mar me ma rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā sa rdo rje blangs la/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje gsor byas la/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das par sgrol/ /chos kyi rnam par dag byed pa/ /rdo rje snying po blang bar gyis/

/ lha nyi shu rtsa bdun du shes pas rdo rje gsor / oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ dril bu blangs/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba shud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da sam+bha we ta badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ngo bor mos nas phyogs brgyad du dkrol lo/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ hūṃ bde ba'i thugs gdan rdo rje can/ /bdag gi mig gis de mthong ngo*/ /yig ge dngos po'i rang bzhin ni/ /stong pa rgyas pa de yin no/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba'i/ /dbus ni rnam par shes byas te/ /yig ge thams cad 'joms byas nas/ /'di ni shin+tu bsam pa yin/ /phan tshun 'khyud nas sbyor ba las/ /'gying bag tu ni 'da' bya'o/ /gnyis med chos ni rnyed gyur nas/ /myang ngan 'das pa 'di thob bo/ /'khor ba'i bya ba ma rmongs na/ /de ni mya ngan las 'das pa/ /rang bzhin kun gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /gar byed smyo ba bzhin du ni/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas te/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du brtag /sna tshogs mang po gzugs sprul pa/ /sems can rnam par smin byed des/ /'khor ba yi ni don byed de/ /chos nyid 'di la ma rmongs na/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thar lam 'di/ /chos kyi snying po phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin du/ / sems can sgrol byed rnal 'byor bdag la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu bdag nyid ngo bo gcig la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rmongs pa gcod la bstod phyag 'tshal/ bdag gis rtag tu de bzhin nyid gcig bstod phyag 'tshal/ / ces pas bstod/ spros pa la dga' na/ bstod pa rgyas pa byed par gzhung nas bshad cing man ngag las kyang mdzad do/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas bdud rtsi'i snod blangs la/ lag mthil g.yas par nyi ma'i steng du thod pa/ g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas kha bkab la/

lag mthil g.yon du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du suṃ dkar po la ā li bcu drug gis bskor ba'o/ de rnams dang sor mo rdo rjer gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas thod pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ ha ho hriḥ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong hūṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi srin lag suṃ las ri rab tu mos/ bsrubs bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams te/ 'bru gsum gyis thigs gtor lan gsum/ mgrin par mchod rten dkar po gnas pa la phul/ de bzhin du snying gar ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ spyi bor bla ma rnams la thigs gtor gsum gsum 'bul/ de nas gong du bstan pa'i sngags rnams kyis nus na lha thams cad la lan gsum gsum 'bul la/ ma nus na gtso mo la lan gsum dang*/ 'khor rnams la re re'o/ /de rnams kyis yan lag bcu bzhi bstan zin to/ /de nas lha'i sku la sems 'dzin na/ lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags sam/ so so'i snying po brjod la/ lha rnams gsal btab ste/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i sku la sems bzung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim gyi yan lag bzlas pa ni/ thog mar bgrang 'phreng bsangs sbyangs/ ye shes kyi lhar gyur bzhu ba las bgrang 'phreng du ltas la/ snyim pa sbyar ba nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du chud par bsam/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dz+nya naṃ sarba bud+dha mahā ud bha we hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho aḥswāhā/ ca ེsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci nus su bzla zhing*/ gtso bo la sum 'bum dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri khrag re re'o/ / oṃ dzuṃ hūṃ swāhā/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i sngags so/ /'dir bla ma rngog pa rnams mtha' na bzhugs pa'i lha nas brtsams te rim gyis bzla ba nā ro pa'i man ngag tu 'dod mod nges par dgos pa ni min no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba'i gdan dang bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/

/rjes thun gyi bya ba la/ gtor ma'i bya ba dang ma 'brel na/ skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu bya ste/ oṃ āt+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ swāhā/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang gi dbugs kyis drangs te lus la zhugs pa ni/ snying gar ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ lce la rdo rje ma spyi gtsug tu drag mo/ rna ba dang sna la ro langs ma/ mig gnyis la gdol ba mo/ mgrin par seng ge ma/ dpung pa gnyis su stag mo/ snying gar ce spyang ma/ lte bar 'ug pa ma/ brla g.yas la rgyal dbang ma/ g.yon la 'bar byed ma/ lag ngar g.yas la 'thib byed ma/ g.yon la g.yo ldan ma rnams thim ste/ gnas de dang der yi ge'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang nyid la thim/ bdag nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ yang thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs la dge ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su/ khrag dang tsan dan gyi gru gsum du byugs pa'i nang zlum skor dang*/ le tshe dgu tshon dkar por 'bri/ de dag las dbus su khrag gi thig le bcu gsum dang*/ re mig brgyad la lnga lnga bya/ gtor ma kha zas bzang dgu la sha dang nya dang byi kyu dang 'bru dang zas kyi bye brag 'byor tshad dbul/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dngos sam mtshon byed bsres la me tog dmar po'i la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga bshams/ bdag bskyed kyi mtha' dkyil 'khor ma bsdus pa'i skabs yin na/ de'i dbus su dkyil 'khor dmigs/ dur khrod la phyogs skyong rnams spyan 'dren/ rang nyid las kyi lha mor zur du bye nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i las byed par bsam dgos shing*/ dus skabs gzhan dang bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i mtha' la yin na/ bdag nyid gtso mor skad cig gis bskyed la/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa lha lnga'am/ gtso mo kho na spros kyang rung ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du skad cig gis bzhugs par bsam/

de nas phyogs skyong rnams spyan drangs te 'god pa yin no/ /de'i phyir maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu yang lha grangs dang mthun par 'god dgos so/ /de la ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba bi ma la saṃ shodha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las yum las rlung*/ k+ṣuṃ las me/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las sgyed pu gsum/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang gi dbus dang shar nas g.yon skor gyi hūṃ suṃ k+ṣuṃ yuṃ hūṃ rnams las gzhi mnyam dri chu rak+ta khu ba ngar snabs rnams re re yang 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge lnga po de rnams tshar re res mtshan pa/ rdzas lnga po so so'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi'i yig ge a dkar po'o/ /yang de'i steng du dbus dang shar nas g.yas skor gyi hūṃ sriṃ griṃ dz+riṃ hūṃ las mi ba glang khyi rta glang po'i sha ste lcags kyu lnga po la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin slar yang yi ge de nyid kyis mtshan pa de dag kyang*/ lcags kyu chen po rnam snang mdzad/ rdo rje lcags kyu mi bskyod pa/ gnas kyi lcags kyu rin chen dbang*/ g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'od dpag med/ rgyal po'i lcags kyu don yod grub/ de ltar lcags kyu lnga so so'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la k+ṣuṃ dmar po/ ha hoḥhrīḥha las 'od dpag med ser pos kha dog dang*/ hoḥlas rnam snang dkar pos dri dang*/ hrīḥlas mi bskyod pa sngon pos ro rnams phun sum tshogs par byas/ a k+ṣuṃ zhes brjod pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba 'char ka'i mdangs can dbu ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa dang hūṃ yig las rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ gar gyur pa zhu nas lhung zhing 'dres pa shel gyi rnam pa ltar dngas par gyur/ de'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la ā li kā li rnams gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūṃ brtsegs pa rnams su gyur/
de'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyis bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste/ de la zhugs yi ge gsum dang zla ba yang de nyid la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum brjod de gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor spros dbus kyi re mig tu zhugs par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/ oṃ guṃ swāhā/ ca ེsa pas maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ oṃ brta li brta li ma hā brta li huṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ zhing skyong rnams maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas so sor bzhugs pa ni/ shar du nag po la rgan byad ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang du drag po chen po la rgyal ba ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu lhas sbyin la nag mo bzang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lhor nag po la dbang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang shar du rtsigs byed la 'phrog byed ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ shar lhor 'jigs byed la drag mo'i gzugs la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lho nub tu dga' ba las 'das pa la thod phreng ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub byang du bgegs kyi rgyal po la ral gri la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ gtso bo brgyad ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas na ral gri dang dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams ni g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ g.yon mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ phyogs na gnas pa rnams shar dkar/ byang ser nub dmar lho nag zur thig gi sa la gnas pa gsum gsum ni phyed gzugs can thams cad kyang gcer bu spyan gsum ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ / de nas oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ nas oṃ guṃ swā hā'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ g.yon ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya gtor snod la reg par mos/ g.yas rdo rje sdig mdzub bsgrengs nas gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ 'di skad ces/

oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang gzhi'i/ khyad par du ni khang stong dang*/ /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang*/ khyad par gdol ba'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ lhas sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang*/ /nag po rtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*/ dga' ba la 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang*/ /'jigs byed ma dang u mas bstod/ / rgyal ma rnam par rgyal dbang mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /nag mo sdang ba lam pa kī /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma/ /thod 'phreng 'phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag dang*/ lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams ni/ / mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid dang*/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'dir sbyon cig /oṃ kak+ka ta ban+bha n+dha na/ khakh+khā da na sarba duṣ+tāṃ ha na ha na ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a mu ka s+yā i daṃkār+ya bā dha ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing se gol gtog lag gnyis khu tshur rgyab spras pa'i srin lag sbrel la/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo ga yo gī shwa rwi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ ces lan mang du brjod la/ rang gi dam tshig la gnas par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/

/dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang dbye dang dgug pa dang*/ /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba yi/ /las kyi dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi gtong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces 'phrin las gzhol/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol/ phan tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor ldan pa/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni brgyan pa 'di/ /mgon po lus la mdzes pa'i sku/ /dngos las grol ba bdag phyag 'tshal/ ces glu blangs nas dril bu sil bzhin du/ sems can sgrol mdzod sogs kyis bstod/ /de nas gtor chog tsam yin na/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gi sgrol/ /ma grol ba rnam bdag gis dgrol/ /de ltararjes su brtse ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bdag bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i smon lam btab/ oṃ sarba duṣ+tan pra duṣ+tān ha na ha na gṛh+na gṛh+na kha kha khā hi khā hi gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bha wa pu nā rā ga ma nā ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod de se gol gtog /'jig rten pa'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas sa la brkyang ste/ oṃ at+ma tiṣ+ta swāhā/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu ba gong bzhin pas/ gzhal med khang bsdu ba mi dgos/ mjug tu smon lam dang bkra shis la sogs pa bya'o/ /gal te tshogs mchod dang 'brel ba yin na/ dang por gtor ma gnyis bshams/ tshogs rdzas dang lhan cig byin gyis brlab nas/ phud gcig 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma la sbran/

phud gnyis ba phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la sbran/ gong bzhin bsngos nas bstod pa yan chad song ba na/ bar 'dir tshigs bcad kyis 'dren cing tshigs bcad kyi blangs/ rang rang gi phud nas bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs la bsngos/ tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus/ lhag ma dang po dud sol ma la 'bul ba ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bkab la/ chang gis kha khru btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ byin gyis brlabs/ mdzub mo mche ba'i phyag rgya kha 'gram du bzung la/ oṃ bhu brta li brta li/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ ku ru ku ru brta li brta li/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gtsig byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig bsrung ma khrag dga' ma/ /ki li sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ / dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su/ /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru/ /gsol cig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gis las ni ci byed kyang*/ /de la kun gyis grogs mdzod cig oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na sarba duṣ+tāṃ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa phuṃ phreṃ phroṃ phriṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod la se gol gsum gtog pas gshegs su gsol/ shin tu lhag ma chu dang sbyar te/ oṃ u tsi ṭa ha ri bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas te lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal lo/ /de nas nang du 'ong nas bkra shis kyi glu blang ba ni/ te na hūṃ te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ ston ka'i zla bzhin mdzes pa'i zhal/ /zla ba ltar dkar sku gtsang ma/ de na hūṃ sogs/ phun tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor 'chang ba/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya mchog /te na hūṃ sogs/ / 'gro ba la khyab rdzu 'phrul sku/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi gzugs can te/ /te na hūṃ sogs/ rang dgar sems can grol mdzad pa/ /rkyen gzugs gang de la phyag 'tshal/ te na hūṃ sogs/ /bkra shis dbyangs kyis bkang byas te/

/thams cad kun gyis glur blang ngo*/ / de nas yig ge brgya pa bzla bzhin du/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ sems can thams cad nad med sogs smon lam btab/ swa bhā wa dang*/ badz+ra shud+dha dang*/ yo ka shud+dho 'i sngags gsum brjod/ don yid la bzhag oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā bhā wa naṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor mgron dang*/ oṃ sarba duṣ+taṃ= sogs sam/ oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa pu na rā ga ma nā ya dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes se gol lan gsum gdab pas 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ oṃ āt+ma tiṣ+ṭha sogs gong nyer bsdus skabs su bstan pa bzhin byas nas/ mthar smon lam dang bkra shis kyang ci 'grub bya'o/ /'di ni rgyud rgyas pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ cho ga rgyas par sbyar ba ār+ya de ba'i gzhung la/ bla ma'i man ngag lag len sbyar ba ltar bshad pa yin la/ da lta'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa kho na'i lugs ni bha ba bha dra dang*/ a bha ya'i gzhung ltar yin no/ /lugs de yang nyams len la mkho bas logs su 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni nongs na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ / dge ba gang de mkha' dang mnyam gyur nas/ /lhan skyes gdod ma'i shes rab mchog de dang*/ /yid gcugs rdo rje sems dpa' mngon gyur sho /ces dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas gzhan la phan pa'i phyir nges par sbyar ba ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i rgyud gzhung 'grel pa man ngag gi nges gsang cha tsam rig nas/ snying po'i don shin tu 'khyer bde bar brjod pa ste/ sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po jo nang du nges par sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/
